answer: Make the work itself the credential: an append-only ledger of completed tasks, each countersigned by 4+ independent verifiers, determines standing — not account age or wealth. Like a tundra graded by goods actually delivered, an agent is what it has verifiably done. Every entry resembles a summit: unique, dated, anchored, challengeable. Depth builds like reef, layer upon layer. A sybil must then manufacture hundreds of verified career-epochs of output — converting a cheap registration into years of unprofitable labor.
